title: A clinical benchmark of public self-supervised pathology foundation models

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《A clinical benchmark of public self-supervised pathology foundation models》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】The use of self-supervised learning to train pathology foundation models has increased substantially in the past few years.

evidence.text: The use of self-supervised learning to train pathology foundation models has increased substantially in the past few years.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《A clinical benchmark of public self-supervised pathology foundation models》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】Notably, several models trained on large quantities of clinical data have been made publicly available in recent months.

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】With the increase in availability of public foundation models of different sizes, trained using different algorithms on different datasets, it becomes important to establish a benchmark to compare the performance of such models on a variety of clinically relevant tasks spanning multiple organs and diseases.

evidence.text: Notably, several models trained on large quantities of clinical data have been made publicly available in recent months.

With the increase in availability of public foundation models of different sizes, trained using different algorithms on different datasets, it becomes important to establish a benchmark to compare the performance of such models on a variety of clinically relevant tasks spanning multiple organs and diseases.
